Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (80% backend)
description_html:
Headquarters: Remote

Postscript is the AI-powered, all-in-one retention platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands, including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

Our mission is to maximize the lifetime value of every shopper. We built the best-in-class SMS platform, expanded into email, and launched revenue-driving AI products you won’t find anywhere else. Now we’re building the most AI-forward team in ecommerce, and we’re just getting started.

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator. Fully remote since 2018.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Postscript, you'll be a high-ownership contributor to one of our core product or platform teams — owning meaningful systems end-to-end, driving technical quality, and helping shape how we build across the organization. Our engineering teams operate at the intersection of scale and product velocity, which means you'll be working on distributed systems that matter to the business while also influencing the technical standards that allow Postscript to grow sustainably.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well — without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day-to-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it.

This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.

Primary Duties

  • Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team — becoming the go-to technical expert for what you own
  • Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
  • Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use
  • Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction — improving long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
  • Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work
  • Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows — not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams — communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
  • Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
  • Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

What We'll Love About You

  • 6+ years of experience building large-scale backend systems and APIs
  • You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
  • Tech stack: Python, Go, React, and TypeScript; experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Datadog, and relational/NoSQL databases. You run agentic workflows autonomously and concurrently.
  • You follow the AI tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually — they're things you're tracking in real time
  • You think critically about AI output — you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces
  • You are able to context switch extremely quickly across concurrent workstreams
  • Experience working on both 0-to-1 initiatives and complex existing systems — and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there
  • Strong command of relational and NoSQL databases, SQL, and thoughtful database modeling
  • Familiarity building and observing applications on AWS, and ideally with Datadog or comparable observability tooling
  • Clear, direct communication — cross-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively
  • Strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities

What You'll Love About Us

  • Salary range of USD $175,000–$220,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo-based salaries)
  • High growth startup — plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career
  • Work from home (or wherever in US / Canada)
  • Fun — we're passionate and enjoy what we do
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Health, dental, vision insurance

For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-senior-software-engineer-full-stack-80-backend

title: Senior CX Platform Engineer
Senior Software Engineer - Growth
Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise Platform
description_html:
Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (West Coast)

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.

Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.
  • Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.
  • Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.
  • Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.
  • Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.

What You Should Have

  • 6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.
  • Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.
  • Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.
  • A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.
  • Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.
  • Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$248,000—$310,000 USD

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/discord-staff-software-engineer-enterprise-platform
